title.tr: Atölyede kapaklı açık tonlu çam kasa
title.en: Pale pine chest with a lid in the workshop

alt.tr: Atölyede fayans zeminde dikey tahtalı, kapaklı, açık renkli emprenyeli çam sandık, arkada atölye tezgâhı
alt.en: Pale pressure-treated pine chest with vertical boards and a lid standing on a tiled workshop floor

caption.tr: Kasa dikey tahtalarla örülmüş, üst kapağı tek parça. Kapağın ucunda küçük bir tutamak var.
caption.en: The chest is built of vertical boards with a one-piece lid and a small handle at its end.
